hint.vulkan: Viewport and scissor are dynamic state, so they must be set in the command buffer: the whole `swapChainExtent`, depth 0 to 1. `vkCmdDraw(commandBuffer, static_cast<uint32_t>(vertices.size()), 1, 0, 0)`.

hint.opengl: 6 indices = 2 triangles; the last argument is the offset into the bound EBO. Uncomment `glPolygonMode(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_LINE)` to see the triangles in wireframe.
